title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Hold-Back Share of a Liquidated Loan's Unrecovered Loss by Repayment Record
content:
When entitlement is restored on a liquidated VA Home Loan Guaranty loan, entitlement is held back as a share of the unrecovered guaranty loss, and the share turns on whether the Home Loan Guaranty Debt that arose from the loan is under a repayment plan and on how many payments were received on the veteran's VA debts in the last three months, as the veteran's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records show them.

## The share held back

| The Home Loan Guaranty Debt from the loan | Payments received on the veteran's VA debts within the last three months counted back from today | Share of the unrecovered loss held back |
|---|---|---|
| Under a repayment plan | At least 3 | The current-plan share, one half (0.5) |
| Under a repayment plan | Fewer than 3 | The lapsed-plan share, three quarters (0.75) |
| Any other state | Any number | The whole unrecovered loss (1) |

The payments counted are payment-received entries on any of the veteran's VA debts, not only on the home loan guaranty debt, dated within the three months counted back from today.

## Cases (hypothetical, unrecovered loss of 10,000.00 dollars)

| Debt state | Payments in the last three months | Share | Amount at that share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Repayment plan | 4 | 0.5 | 5,000.00 |
| Repayment plan | 3 | 0.5 | 5,000.00 |
| Repayment plan | 2 | 0.75 | 7,500.00 |
| Active collection, no plan | 5 | 1 | 10,000.00 |

Three payments meet the current-plan number; two do not.
